title: ControlPlanePrRecord
description: SPEC §4.5, ADR-0040 D3: one pull request under the local PR host adapter (plane.json `pr_host.adapter: local`), QUEUE_ROOT/prs/<n>.json, written by ccp/prhost.py through `ccp pr` and `ccp tasks close`.

number.description: Given by the plane: one more than the highest held, under prs/.lock

branch.description: The pushed head branch on origin

base.description: The branch it merges into: the integration branch

body.description: The PR's text; `ccp pr edit` replaces it

head.description: The head last seen on origin/<branch>

merged_at.description: Set when the merge is confirmed on origin/<base>

merge_commit.description: The squash commit pushed to <base>; empty until the merge
